page_title: PAU 1-1 KOL | St. Pauli v FC Koln 17/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) has tested the patience of referee Matthias Jollenbeck and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+3' Cenk Ozkacar (1. FC Koln) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
90+2' The ball goes out of play and FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for FC Koln.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) comes onto the pitch so that Mathias Pereira Lage can be given a rest.
87' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) receives a yellow card.
87' A yellow-coloured card is received by Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli).
86' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Nikola Vasilj no chance!
86' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) is going to take the penalty!
85' It’s a PENALTY to FC Koln after the VAR review!
84' There's a break in play and referee Matthias Jollenbeck must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by FC Koln using VAR. This could be interesting!
83' One of the FC Koln players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
79' Here comes a substitution. Isak Johannesson is given a rest as he is replaced by Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln).
79' Here comes a substitution. Felipe Chavez (1. FC Koln) is brought on as a substitute for Sebastian Sebulonsen.
78' The attendance is 29546.
77' Here is a change. Andreas Hountondji is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli).
76' Matthias Jollenbeck shows a yellow card to Tomoya Ando (St. Pauli) for his blatant foul.
71' Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
70' Substitution. Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) on for Alessio Castro-Montes.
69' 1 - 0 Goal! Hauke Wahl finds Karol Mets (St. Pauli) with a headed pass and the latter glances a header past the goalkeeper to make it 1:0.
69' St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
68' The current number of shots on goal is 5:0.
66' Mathias Rasmussen (St. Pauli) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
65' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to St. Pauli.
65' It is time for a substitution. Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) is on for Lars Ritzka.
62' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post.
61' The ball goes out for a corner. FC Koln can continue in their attacking effort.
61' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
58' St. Pauli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
58' St. Pauli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

57' Tomoya Ando (St. Pauli) has a good opportunity as he meets a cross on the edge of the six-yard box and heads it towards the target. One of the defenders stands on the goal line and manages to keep the ball out.
56' The resulting set piece from St. Pauli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

56' Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Marvin Schwabe guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save.
55' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
54' Surely that's handball by one of the St. Pauli players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
51' Rene Wagner is forced to make a change. Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Marius Bulter.
51' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
51' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
46' Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
46' Rene Wagner decides to make a substitution. Jan Thielmann will be replaced by Linton Maina (1. FC Koln).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' A rebound bounces out to Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' FC Koln have a corner.
45' Cenk Ozkacar (1. FC Koln) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
42' FC Koln string together a series of short passes.
34' The corner is swung in but St. Pauli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
31' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Tomoya Ando (St. Pauli), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
28' A pass by Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
28' FC Koln fail to score from a corner as Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli) leaps to collect the ball.

27' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and FC Koln will take a corner.
26' Some great controlled play and passing from St. Pauli. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
23' The possession of the ball – 61:39.
21' St. Pauli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
17' FC Koln are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
11' A header by Andreas Hountondji (St. Pauli) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past Marvin Schwabe, who makes a nice save.
10' St. Pauli force a corner. They send men into the box.
9' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
6' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) attempts to put the ball in from a rebound with his long-range shot, but it isn't accurate enough, and the ball goes high over the crossbar.
3' FC Koln are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' The first half has just begun.

FC Koln will kick-off.
